title: Ali ka darwaza
body:
Ali ka darwaza
Bhala azim hay kitna, Ali ka darvaza (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Fazilato ne bhi dhoundha, Ali ka darvaza
1. Khare the log bohot intezar mé lekin (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sitara dekh ke utra Ali ka darvaza
2. Nabi ke shehr me tum kis tarha se jaoge (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ke raaste me padega Ali ka darvaza
3. Qassam hai khanae Kaba tere tabassum ki (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Khuda ke ghar me bhi dekha Ali ka darvaza
4. Halakato se bachane ke vaste khud ko (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Falan falan ne bhi dhoundha Ali ka darvaza
5. Mukhalefin bhi ye soch kar yahan pohche (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kabhi na band milega Ali ka darvaza
6. Rasool jab shabe meraj arsh par pohche (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Faraze arsh pe dekha Ali ka darvaza
7. Jo dushmanane Ali hay, kahan vo jaenge (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Dare jina pe hay likkha Ali ka darvaza
8. Bilal Buzaro Salman sabhi khade the vahan (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo mayne ghor se dekha Ali ka darvaza
author: Shadman Raza
